name: p2-first-serve-pitch
criterion: For the captured first serve tone, choose the nearest integral legal Paula period to the original frequency. Compare actual AUD3PER after the ordered PSG events are applied; report source/native WAV measurements separately without an unmeasured waveform tolerance.
contract: First lower-serve tone pitch and its initial envelope on the actual native application. This is one P2 event, not complete audio or match/result coverage. Source mono and native channel placement remain explicit; phase/filter/stereo waveforms are not required to be byte-identical.
